summary: Tested Product Management (Add/Edit/Delete modal) and Order Filters on Admin Dashboard. Backend: 6/6 tests passed. Frontend: all flows verified via Playwright and screenshots.

minor.issue: Requires full ProductIn payload (name, retail_price, wholesale_price all required) - not a true partial update. Frontend always sends full object so it works, but semantically PATCH should accept partial fields. Low risk.

critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/admin/products/{id} uses ProductIn (all fields required) instead of a partial update model. This is acceptable since the frontend modal always submits all fields, but consider using Optional fields in future for API cleanliness.

AdminDashboard.js line 321: ProductModal receives `product={modalProduct?.id ? modalProduct : null}` — passes null for add flow which is correct. Minor: the `modalProduct !== null` check for `modalOpen` means passing `{}` opens the modal but `modalProduct?.id` is undefined so isEdit=false — correct behavior, just slightly implicit.
seed_data_creation: Chakri Gold added via UI then deleted. TEST_Chakri Gold leftover from failed backend test run was cleaned up via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features working: (1) Add product modal opens with all fields (name, category dropdown, 8 icon picker, pack type, pack size, retail price, wholesale price, HSN, stock). (2) Edit modal (PenLine icon) opens pre-filled. (3) Delete with inline confirm works. (4) Order filters: date chips (All time/Today/Last 7 days/Last 30 days), status chips (Paid/Pending), type chips (POS/Online) all work client-side. Combined filters work correctly. Backend CRUD: POST/PATCH/DELETE all pass. PATCH requires full payload. data-testid attributes present on all key elements.
rca_of_issues: No critical issues found. PATCH non-partial update is by design since frontend always sends full form.
